title: TSOA Position Estimator
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Direction of Arrival/TSOA_Position_Estimator.md
text: 根据到达时间总和估计目标位置，输入 4 路、输出 2 路；{Signal propagation speed (m/s)} 指定信号传播速度 physconst、{Output covariances of TSOA position estimates (meters-squared)} 指定 TSOA 位置估计的输出协方差、{Simulate using} 指定模块仿真方法 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: TSOAEst
ports.summary: 到达时间总和估计值 (秒) real-valued J -by- L -by- K array

ports.name: TSOAVar
ports.summary: TSOA 估计方差（秒的平方） real-valued J -by- L matrix | real-valued J -by- L -by- K array

ports.name: TxPos
ports.summary: 发射锚点位置（米） real-valued Q -by- J matrix

ports.name: RxPos
ports.summary: 接收锚点位置（米） real-valued Q -by- L matrix

ports.name: TgtPosEst
ports.summary: 目标位置估计 real-valued Q -by-1 vector

ports.name: TgtPosCov
ports.summary: 目标位置协方差矩阵 real-valued positive semi-definite Q -by- Q matrix

params.name: Signal propagation speed (m/s)
params.values: 信号传播速度 physconst("LightSpeed") (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Output covariances of TSOA position estimates (meters-squared)
params.values: TSOA 位置估计的输出协方差 false (0) (default) | true (1)

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 模块仿真方法 Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
